1: // Canvas Runner Game
2: // Implements endless runner per IDEA.md
3: // Enhanced graphics: gradient background, player silhouette, obstacle shading
4: 
5: (function () {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) return;
8:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
10:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 400);
11: 
12:   // Game state
13:   let speed = 2;
14:   let score = 0;
15:   let running = true;
16: 
17:   // Player
18:   const player = {
19:     w: 30,
20:     h: 50,
21:     x: 50,
22:     y: H - 100,
23:     vy: 0,
24:     gravity: 0.6,
25:     jumpStrength: -12,
26:     onGround: false,
27:     draw() {
28:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
29:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
30:     },
31:     update() {
32:       this.vy += this.gravity;
33:       this.y += this.vy;
34:       if (this.y + this.h >= groundY) {
35:         this.y = groundY - this.h;
36:         this.vy = 0;
37:         this.onGround = true;
38:       } else {
39:         this.onGround = false;
40:       }
41:     },
42:     jump() {
43:       if (this.onGround) this.vy = this.jumpStrength;
44:     },
45:   };
46: 
47:   // Ground line
48:   const groundY = H - 50;
49: 
50:   // Obstacles and orbs
51:   const obstacles = [];
52:   const orbs = [];
53:   const obstacleFreq = 120; // frames
54:   const orbFreq = 80;
55:   let frameCount = 0;
56: 
57:   function spawnObstacle() {
58:     const height = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
59:     obstacles.push({ x: W, y: groundY - height, w: 20, h: height });
60:   }
61: 
62:   function spawnOrb() {
63:     const radius = 8;
64:     const y = groundY - 100 - Math.random() * 150;
65:     orbs.push({ x: W, y, r: radius });
66:   }
67: 
68:   function updateObstacles() {
69:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
70:       const o = obstacles[i];
71:       o.x -= speed;
72:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
73:     }
74:   }
75: 
76:   function updateOrbs() {
77:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
78:       const o = orbs[i];
79:       o.x -= speed;
80:       if (o.x + o.r < 0) orbs.splice(i, 1);
81:     }
82:   }
83: 
84:   function checkCollisions() {
85:     // Player vs obstacles
86:     for (const o of obstacles) {
87:       if (
88:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
89:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
90:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
91:         player.y + player.h > o.y
92:       ) {
93:         running = false;
94:         return;
95:       }
96:     }
97:     // Player vs orbs
98:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
99:       const o = orbs[i];
100:       const dx = player.x + player.w / 2 - (o.x + o.r);
101:       const dy = player.y + player.h / 2 - (o.y + o.r);
102:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (player.w / 2 + o.r) ** 2) {
103:         score += 10;
104:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
105:       }
106:     }
107:   }
108: 
109:   function drawBackground() {
110:     // Gradient sky that shifts hue with speed
111:     const hue = Math.floor((speed * 10) % 360);
112:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W, 0);
113:     grad.addColorStop(0, `hsl(${hue}, 80%, 60%)`);
114:     grad.addColorStop(1, `hsl(${(hue + 60) % 360}, 80%, 40%)`);
115:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
116:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, groundY);
117:     // Ground with simple gradient shading
118:     const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, H);
119:     groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#444');
120:     groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
121:     ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
122:     ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, H - groundY);
123:   }
124: 
125:   function drawObstacles() {
126:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
127:     for (const o of obstacles) ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
128:   }
129: 
130:   function drawOrbs() {
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
132:     for (const o of orbs) {
133:       ctx.beginPath();
134:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
135:       ctx.fill();
136:     }
137:   }
138: 
139:   function drawScore() {
140:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
141:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
142:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
143:   }
144: 
145:   function loop() {
146:     if (!running) {
147:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
148:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
149:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
150:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
151:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 60, H / 2);
152:       ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W / 2 - 50, H / 2 + 30);
153:       return;
154:     }
155:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
156: 
157:     // increase speed gradually
158:     speed += 0.001;
159: 
160:     // spawn entities
161:     if (frameCount % obstacleFreq === 0) spawnObstacle();
162:     if (frameCount % orbFreq === 0) spawnOrb();
163: 
164:     updateObstacles();
165:     updateOrbs();
166:     player.update();
167:     checkCollisions();
168: 
169:     drawGround();
170:     drawObstacles();
171:     drawOrbs();
172:     player.draw();
173:     drawScore();
174: 
175:     frameCount++;
176:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
177:   }
178: 
179:   // Input handling
180:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
181:     if (e.code === 'Space') player.jump();
182:   });
183:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => player.jump());
184: 
185:   // Start
186:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
187: })();

(End of file - total 187 lines)
